name: Sound FX
author: izicubed
description: Play custom MP3/WAV/OGG sound files on race events: staging, start, finish, stop, winner declared, every lap, holeshot, pilot finished, race saved and more. Speaks composed phrases: pilot name + lap number on every gate pass, 'next group' announcements with pilot + channel callouts, countdowns to a scheduled race start and to the end of a timed race (minute marks, 30/10/5 s). A Run-page panel shows a status lamp, the phrase being spoken with a mini player (progress bar, play/pause/stop), a live queue feed and a playback-speed slider. Sounds are uploaded from the Settings page and played in every connected browser; a standalone /sound_fx/player page lets any phone or tablet on the network act as a dedicated speaker. Optional playback on the server's own audio output (mpg123/ffplay). No extra dependencies.
